verdict.rationale: Postman ships its own official CLI that runs collections with configuration options and built-in reporters, and the docs explicitly support running test collections in CI/CD pipelines, combined with the Postman API. Newman also runs collections from the command line, so headless automation is clearly a first-party capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and documented detail on headless authentication and exit-code behavior in pipelines.
